PLUS ULTRA: Overexerted.name: PLUS ULTRA: Overexerted
PLUS ULTRA: Overexerted.description:
🥵 You pushed past your limit and your body is paying for it.

📉 For a while: Quirk Output -10, Quirk Control -10, Striking -5, Dodging -5. Rest clears it.
PLUS ULTRA: Overexerted.traitNarrativeEffects: The character pushed past their limit and is paying for it: shaking hands, slow reactions, the Drawback flaring at the smallest use. They cannot push like that again until they have rested.
